abTop.unit: ms a frame (frame interval with it on - off; drain)

summary.abBound: bound: frames 11.1 ms on average against 1.8 at their fastest — the costs show in the interval

cameraSpeed.unit: cells/s, the camera moving straight on with no prefetch beyond the window
cameraSpeed.rule: regions/s x R^2 / W (axis); diagonal: a strip and a column a region moved

gpuBudget.note: the frame period less the parked GPU frame (p50)

tilesPerFrame.rule: half the GPU time left at that rate / colFinish ms a 32x32 tile (the other half for play); a region is 4 tiles + colHeight + formSeed once

precache.unit: at the measured best region rate
precache.note: how much land could be made ahead of a ride or round a warp target a second, if generation had the GPU to itself at that tile rate

sandboxGpuGroups.unit: GPU ms a frame (mean over frames read back)
sandboxGpuGroups.note: draw is the frame draw pass (the lighting and the forward draw); render = gbuffer + shadow + draw + renderprep (renderprep, renderfields, project) + tcache

Only a bound frame shows a system's cost in its interval: at the display's rate (a desktop at vsync) the costs read ~0 and only the drain moves

ab.bound: bound: frames 11.1 ms on average against 1.8 at their fastest — the costs show in the interval

mesh.note: no frame over the parked p95: the hybrid meshes only its voxel chunks (few, parked), so a forced rebuild shows nothing — the per-chunk cost needs a scene with voxel chunks (BACKLOG BN10)
mesh.rule: frames whose field-mesh GPU ms is over the parked p95: their excess over the parked p50, over (those frames x slots a frame)
